| Required input | Status |
|---|---|

| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Provided: 5,000 t |

The nearby entries (CN 7207 11 90 for China at 3.314 tCO2e/t, and CN 7214 20 00 for China at 3.169 tCO2e/t) are different goods. Under the ruleset, the SEE is selected by the exact CN code and country, so I cannot substitute either one.

**To complete the calculation, please provide one of the following:**
1. A default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7208, produced in China, from the applicable default value table, or
2. An updated factor table that includes CN 7208 for China.

Once that value is supplied, the calculation is SEE × 5,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
